mathematics.assertion_tested: A time-dependent canonical momentum shift gives the same fixed-action conserved dust response as the original canonical variables for k=100, t in [0,4], gamma=1e-6, amplitude=1e-7; transformed DOP853 and Radau agree on 161 common sample times.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE754 float64 numerical integration and exact rational symbolic coordinate identities
mathematics.conventions: M2=1, normalized real cosine mode, rho=amplitude/a^3, zeta(0)=zetadot(0)=0, no change to constitutive coefficients
non_claims: No nonlinear solution or universal stability result
Finite sampling and solver tolerances do not certify a whole domain
